The routine we recommend to anyone starting out. Journal routines Most skin needs less than you think. The evening is when it does most of its repair work, so that is where a routine earns its place. Start with three steps, keep them for a month, and add more only when you know why. Cleanse Your skin has collected sunscreen, pollution and the day’s oil, and none of it should stay on overnight. Massage the gentle cleansing gel onto wet skin for a full thirty seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water. Hot water feels good but strips the skin, so keep it warm, never hot. If you wear heavy make up or water resistant sunscreen, cleanse twice. The first wash lifts the product, the second actually cleans the skin. Treat Pat your face almost dry, leaving it slightly damp.
